summary: Invesco Commercial Real Estate Finance Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare monthly and special cash distributions for August 2026. Gross distributions of $0.1800 per share consist of $0.1600 monthly plus $0.0200 special. Class-specific stockholder servicing fees reduce net amounts, ranging from $0.1619 to $0.1800. Record date is August 31, 2026; payment on September 15, 2026. Distributions are payable in cash or reinvested under the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation, with no deal terms or strategic implications.
